stories.title: IMF applauds India’s GDP data revamp, says country entered energy shock with strong fundamentals
stories.summary: The International Monetary Fund praised India’s recent overhaul of its gross domestic product data and said the country has entered an energy shock while retaining strong economic fundamentals. This comment was reported in a headline by the Economic Times.
stories.why: Changes in the global growth outlook can influence markets, trade, borrowing conditions and business investment across countries.

stories.title: US inflation exceeds expectations in year to September
stories.summary: Official data show US inflation rose more than forecast for the year to September, the final release before the upcoming midterm elections. The increase was driven by higher petrol prices after Middle East energy supplies were disrupted by the US‑Israel conflict with Iran. Cost‑of‑living pressures are a central issue in the election campaign.
stories.why: Inflation data can shift expectations for central-bank interest rates, bond yields, borrowing costs and household purchasing power.
stories.previousTitle: US inflation rises more than expected
stories.previousSummary: US inflation rose by more than expected in the year to September, according to official figures, in the final data release before the midterm elections next month. For example, if a bottle of milk costs $1 but rises to $1.10 a year later, then annual inflation for bottled milk is 10%.
